item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. You've got structure in the day — meals, movement, breaks built in. The risk isn't the plan, it's autopilot: eating while distracted, skipping ahead, or grazing between the blocks you've set. Notice what's on your plate before you eat it, not after. Action: before your next meal, name it out loud — what's on it, why now.
